metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Beijing, Chongqing, and Wuhan all decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: `COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFLINE/L3_NO2` (S5P Tropospheric NO₂). - Two periods: `2020-01-01 – 2020-01-20` and `2020-02-10 – 2020-02-25`. - Three cities: Beijing (39.9, 116.4), Chongqing (29.6, 106.5), Wuhan (30.6, 114.3) → 10 km radius buffers. 2. Masking strategy: - Use the `tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density` band. - Apply the `qa_value` ≥ 0.75 bit-mask (recommended for S5P). 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null/Error: - After masking, reduce each period with `ee.Reducer.mean()` inside each city buffer. - Check `.size()` → if 0 ⇒ C1. - Check pixel count with `ee.Reducer.count()` → if 0 ⇒ C2. - If any result is None/NaN ⇒ C3; else compare means to decide A/B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') beijing = ee.Geometry.Point(116.4, 39.9).buffer(10000) chongqing = ee.Geometry.Point(106.5, 29.6).buffer(10000) wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point(114.3, 30.6).buffer(10000) cities = {'Beijing': beijing, 'Chongqing': chongqing, 'Wuhan': wuhan} def get_no2_mean(label, geom, start, end): col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFLINE/L3_NO2') .filterDate(start, end) .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density', 'qa_value'])) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: return None, 0 masked = col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75))) mean = (masked.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') .mean() .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')) cnt = (masked.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') .mean() .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')) return mean.getInfo(), cnt.getInfo() jan_means, feb_means = {}, {} for name, geom in cities.items(): j_mean, j_cnt = get_no2_mean(name, geom, '2020-01-01', '2020-01-20') f_mean, f_cnt = get_no2_mean(name, geom, '2020-02-10', '2020-02-25') if j_mean is None or f_mean is None: print("No data for", name) print("C1") exit() if j_cnt == 0 or f_cnt == 0: print("No valid pixels for", name) print("C2") exit() jan_means[name] = j_mean feb_means[name] = f_mean print(f"{name} Jan: {j_mean:.3e} Feb: {f_mean:.3e}") all_down = all(feb_means[c] < jan_means[c] for c in cities) print("A" if all_down else "B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

beijing = ee.Geometry.Point(116.4, 39.9).buffer(10000)
chongqing = ee.Geometry.Point(106.5, 29.6).buffer(10000)
wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point(114.3, 30.6).buffer(10000)
cities = {'Beijing': beijing, 'Chongqing': chongqing, 'Wuhan': wuhan}

def get_no2_mean(label, geom, start, end):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFLINE/L3_NO2')
             .filterDate(start, end)
             .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density', 'qa_value']))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        return None, 0
    masked = col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75)))
    mean = (masked.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
                   .mean()
                   .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                                 geometry=geom,
                                 scale=1000,
                                 maxPixels=1e9)
                   .get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'))
    cnt = (masked.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
                .mean()
                .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                              geometry=geom,
                              scale=1000,
                              maxPixels=1e9)
                .get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'))
    return mean.getInfo(), cnt.getInfo()

jan_means, feb_means = {}, {}
for name, geom in cities.items():
    j_mean, j_cnt = get_no2_mean(name, geom, '2020-01-01', '2020-01-20')
    f_mean, f_cnt = get_no2_mean(name, geom, '2020-02-10', '2020-02-25')
    if j_mean is None or f_mean is None:
        print("No data for", name)
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()
    if j_cnt == 0 or f_cnt == 0:
        print("No valid pixels for", name)
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        exit()
    jan_means[name] = j_mean
    feb_means[name] = f_mean
    print(f"{name} Jan: {j_mean:.3e}  Feb: {f_mean:.3e}")

all_down = all(feb_means[c] < jan_means[c] for c in cities)
print("<answer>A</answer>" if all_down else "<answer>B</answer>")
